description: ARB - Architects Registration Board - The list of Chartered Architects, Architects and Architectural licentiates registered in the (ARB) for the Year 2023
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the registration and renewal of registration for architects (Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates) for the year 2023/2024 by the Architects Registration Board. This is a business/commercial matter involving the licensing and certification of professionals to practice their trade, which falls under the Commercial Gazettes category (Type 6). It does not involve government structure/personnel, land, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
